# MailMint

> MailMint is an inbound email parsing API: send email to a hosted address or POST raw MIME to `/v1/parse`, and get back the fields you described as JSON. Every field carries a computed confidence, the layer it came from (rules, model or both) and the verbatim text of the message it was read from; anything doubtful sets `needs_review: true`. Results arrive by signed webhook, by polling, or in n8n through the `n8n-nodes-mailmint` community node. Free plan: 300 parsed emails a month, no card.

MailMint is operated by productivity-boost.com Betriebs UG (haftungsbeschränkt) & Co. KG, Passau, Germany, and runs on a single server in Finland (EU). Part of the Mint APIs family with PDFMint and DocMint.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/quickstart): API key, first parse, first mailbox
- [API documentation](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/docs): endpoints, schema field types, confidence rules, webhooks and signatures, events
- [API reference](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/docs/reference): every endpoint with request and response
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/openapi.json): machine-readable API description
- [n8n node](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/n8n): install `n8n-nodes-mailmint`, schema editor on the canvas, trigger by webhook or polling

## Pricing

- [Plans](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/#pricing): Free $0 (300 emails/month), Starter $9/month (5,000), Pro $29/month (25,000), Scale $99/month (150,000)

## Guides and use cases

- [Email to JSON](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/email-to-json): what a raw .eml becomes after MIME decoding, reply stripping, table and entity detection
- [Email to webhook](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/email-to-webhook): a mailbox address that POSTs each message as signed JSON to your endpoint
- [Email parsing API](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/email-parsing-api): how MailMint compares as a developer API
- [Parse invoice emails](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/parse-invoice-emails)
- [Parse order confirmation emails](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/parse-order-confirmation-emails)
- [Parse shipping notification emails](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/parse-shipping-notification-emails)
- [Parse lead emails](https://mailmint.app.mintapis.com/parse-lead-emails)
